defs.def: a round fruit with shiny red or green skin and firm white flesh 苹果

ex.s: For example, every morning, my dad has to have the bowl of egg soup while I had to eat an apple.
ex.t: 例如，每天早上，我爸爸都要喝那碗蛋花汤，而我必须吃一个苹果。

ex.s: My dad don’t like the soup and I don’t enjoy apples.
ex.t: 爸爸不喜欢那碗汤，我也不喜欢苹果。

ex.s: Neither is there pine nor apple in pineapple.
ex.t: 菠萝里既没有松树，也没有苹果。

ex.s: When it came to England, “apple” was added to show it is a kind of fruit.
ex.t: 说到英语，加了“apple”以表明它是一种水果。

ex.s: Fruit teas now include mango, strawberry, apple and pear.
ex.t: 果茶现在包括芒果、草莓、苹果和梨。

ex.s: Some have even questioned the story about the apple that fell on Newton’s head and led him to come up with his theory of gravity.
ex.t: 有些人甚至质疑那个掉在牛顿头上、促使他提出引力理论的故事。

ex.s: In fact, more than one account suggests that while Newton was certainly inspired by a falling apple, there is no proof that it hit him on the head.
ex.t: 事实上，不止一种记载表明，虽然牛顿确实受落下的苹果启发，但没有证据证明苹果砸到了他头上。
